CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 07 / 12

Price ceilings and floors

Rationing and surplus配給與剩餘

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Assess consumer and producer surplus under controls carefully: the identity of buyers or sellers who actually trade matters. Without an efficient-rationing assumption, the exact welfare areas may not be determined from supply and demand curves alone.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

管制後的剩餘取決於誰成功買賣。常見圖形面積假設商品到最高價值買家、由最低成本賣家供應；隨機或偏好配給可再減少剩餘。

Surplus depends on who receives or supplies the traded units. The usual maximum-surplus areas under a control assume high-value buyers receive goods and low-cost sellers supply them. Random or discriminatory allocation can reduce surplus further.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：One unit costs $2. At a $3 ceiling, allocating it to a buyer valuing it at $10 gives total surplus $8; to a $5 buyer gives $3. 同交易量，配給不同令剩餘不同。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Under a shortage, can exact CS always be calculated without knowing who buys? 不知誰買到時可必定算出 CS？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
